Brake assist senses panic braking and applies maximum available stopping force, improving your ability to avoid sudden hazards when every fraction of a second counts.  Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls makes setting and adjusting highway speed effortless from the wheel, reducing driver fatigue and helping maintain steady fuel usage.  Keyfob engine start control lets you warm up or cool down the cabin before you get in, so your Civic is comfortable from the moment you step inside.
